Alright, welcome to module one. This is the offer and USP foundations lesson.
Everything we build later sits on top of the offer, so if the offer is weak, the ads are weak, the DMs are weak, everything is weak.
So let's start with the niche.
The question I get the most is which niche should I pick.
And my answer is always the same. Pick a niche that can afford you, that you can reach, and that already spends money on the problem.
If they don't already spend money on the problem, you're going to spend your whole life educating them.
Go narrow first. Physio clinics in one region is better than health businesses everywhere.
You can always widen later once you have case results that are real and verified.
Now the USP. We use one formula for every single offer in this programme.
I help who get outcome in timeframe through mechanism without pain.
Say it with me. I help who, get what outcome, in what timeframe, through what mechanism, without what pain.
The who has to be specific. Business owners is not a who. Dental clinics with two to five chairs is a who.
The outcome has to be measurable. More growth is not an outcome. Twenty new patient bookings a month is an outcome.
The timeframe has to be realistic. Don't say seven days if it takes ninety.
The mechanism is your named method. This is what makes you different from every other agency.
And the pain is the thing they hate doing today. Cold calling, discounting, posting every day, whatever it is.
A quick test for your USP. Read it to a friend once. If they can't repeat it back, it's too long.
Another test. If any competitor could say the same thing, your mechanism isn't sharp enough.
And please, never put a guarantee in your USP. Promise a direction, not a result.
Let's talk about the offer stack for a second.
The core offer is the done-with-you service. Then you have the onboarding, the reporting, the support.
Don't stack ten bonuses. Three meaningful pieces beat ten fluffy ones.
The price should be tied to the outcome. If the outcome is worth a lot to the client, the price can be higher.
Homework for this module. Write three versions of your USP using the formula, then pick the one a stranger can repeat back.
Post it in the community thread and a coach will review it within forty-eight hours.
That's it for module one. Next module we get into DM setting.
